events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking strong.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today. Wonder if he's celebrating with a cuppa or something stronger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 51
angles.copy: More than just a song, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released today in 1975 and its message still resonates globally.

events.title: The Original iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Which 007 film is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece, still debated today.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: A true classic turns 61 today. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game back in '65.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician and activist continues to inspire generations.
